_comment: Local U1-CHAR.4 run (run_u4_local.ps1). limbCount "auto" = rig droplet/zephyr/steamdrake only when the mesh measurement is unambiguous (2 or 4 feet, high confidence); otherwise the batch report states the measurement and the rig is refused. These are not GDD values: replace "auto" with the art director's number once confirmed. Leave yawOffset null unless a model faces the wrong way (the report then shows a facing warning).
